LESSON: NULLIFIERS OF SWALAH

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Devotional Acts
Topic 4.1: Nullifiers of Swalah

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Nullifiers of Swalah. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why should one safeguard swalah?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. perform swalah correctly to earn thawab from Allah
2. appreciate performance of swalah by avoiding its nullifiers

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: NULLIFIERS OF SWALAH
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 5
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Nullifiers of Swalah helps you succeed in ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: NULLIFIERS OF SWALAH
Study Nullifiers of Swalah like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Perform swalah correctly to earn thawab from Allah

What this means
In this part you learn to perform swalah correctly to earn thawab from Allah. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: perform swalah correctly to earn thawab from Allah.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Nullifiers of Swalah” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can perform swalah correctly to earn thawab from Allah. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Appreciate performance of swalah by avoiding its nullifiers

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate performance of swalah by avoiding its nullifiers. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate performance of swalah by avoiding its nullifiers.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Nullifiers of Swalah in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate performance of swalah by avoiding its nullifiers. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Nullifiers of Swalah is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Nullifiers of Swalah” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: perform swalah correctly to earn thawab from Allah)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Nullifiers of Swalah in your own words. (skill: appreciate performance of swalah by avoiding its nullifiers)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Nullifiers of Swalah to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: perform swalah correctly to earn thawab from Allah.
3. Practise this skill: appreciate performance of swalah by avoiding its nullifiers.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Nullifiers of Swalah from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Nullifiers of Swalah: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 5 learner study Nullifiers of Swalah?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should one safeguard swalah?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Nullifiers of Swalah means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: perform swalah correctly to earn thawab from Allah.
5. Be able to: appreciate performance of swalah by avoiding its nullifiers.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
